sentences.text: The fossil includes connected bones such as wings, shoulder girdle, vertebrae, and hind limbs.
It shows specific traits of Columbiformes and Sandgrouses, including a notarium and a short coracoid shaft.
The species Linxiavis inaquosus was described by Li et al. in 2020.

Evidence suggests sandgrouse like this species may have continuously occupied arid, high-elevation Tibetan habitats since the late Miocene, carrying water in modified breast feathers to feed their young.
Linxiavis belongs to the family Pteroclidae.
Linxiavis lived during the Tortonian to Messinian stages, between 11.63 and 5.333 million years ago.
